411: they left it all in the end and went away from here;
now they have become like a dream, and no one even recalls them.
Why then do you not remember God's Name? ॥1॥
Those who forget God and stay attached to other things
wander in the round of birth and death.
has become master of spiritual life.
The one on whom God is merciful,
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਹਉ; ਕਉਨ ਸਿਉ. ਮਨ ਕੀ ॥
To whom can I tell the sorry state of this mind?
ਲੋਭਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਦਸ ਹੂ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਤ; ਆਸਾ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਧਨ ਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Gripped by greed it runs in all ten directions, and the craving to amass wealth clings to it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੁਖ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ. ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਤ; ਸੇਵ ਕਰਤ. ਜਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
Seeking happiness it flatters one person after another, and so suffers pain instead.
ਦੁਆਰਹਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ. ਸੁਆਨ ਜਿਉ ਡੋਲਤ; ਨਹ ਸੁਧ. ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ॥੧॥
Like a dog it wanders from door to door, and never has the sense to worship God. ॥1॥
ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ. ਅਕਾਰਥ ਖੋਵਤ; ਲਾਜ ਨ. ਲੋਕ ਹਸਨ ਕੀ ॥
It wastes this human birth for nothing, and feels no shame at people's mockery.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ. ਕਿਉ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਤ; ਕੁਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਤਨ ਕੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੩੩॥
O Nanak, why do you not sing God's praises? Through them your evil thinking would be removed. ॥2॥1॥233॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
One who comes down from the hard pass of pride and bathes in the pool of the holy company,
ਬਕੈ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
who does not chatter idly but sings God's virtues,
rises to a high spiritual state, as the sea's water rises into the sky;
ਰਸੁ ਸਤੁ ਝੋਲਿ; ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
stirring the nectar of peace, he drinks the supreme nectar of the Name. ॥1॥
O my mind, hear this teaching on deep union with God:
ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਸਭ ਠਉਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
God fills every place and gives support everywhere. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਚੁ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਨੇਮੁ; ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥
One who has made the eternal Lord his daily vow and daily practice, and whom death does not trouble,
burns away his anger through the true Guru's word,
dwells in the high spiritual realm and stays joined to the Lord's feet in deep absorption,
and by touching the Guru, the philosopher's stone, attains the highest spiritual state. ॥2॥
One who, to bring his mind under control, keeps remembering the eternal Lord as milk is churned,
and washes himself in the brimming pool where no filth of vice exists,
becomes like the Lord he loves,
and sees that whatever the Creator Himself does is what happens. ॥3॥
One who meets the Guru, cool as snow, and puts out the fire of craving within,
and keeps his attention on the service the Guru teaches, as if smearing such ashes on his body,
stays always in stillness of mind; know that he has taken up the true garb.
Such a person keeps playing the instrument of the Guru's pure word, full of the Lord's praise. ॥4॥
One who has found deep union with God within and drinks the supreme nectar of the Name,
who has made reflection on the Guru's word his bathing at the places of pilgrimage,
who has made his heart a temple for God and worships Him within,
merges his own light into God's light. ॥5॥
One whose mind is soaked in the nectar of the Name, whose understanding is steeped in love of the one Lord,
ends the five vices and dwells steady within, as on a throne;
walking in the Master's will becomes his daily work and daily earning,
and he takes the form of that Master who is unseen and whose form cannot be told. ॥6॥
ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੈ; ਜਲ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
The sun or moon shines in the water, yet is far away from it,
and its light glitters in the water; so God's light pervades all beings everywhere.
I cannot say to whom He is near and from whom He is far.
Seeing Him present everywhere, I sing the praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtues. ॥7॥
Within beings and outside in all creation there is none but God;
412: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
whatever pleases Him is what happens in the world.
Listen, Bhartari the yogi: Nanak tells you this thought.
The pure Name of that all-pervading Lord is the support of my life. ॥8॥1॥
ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ; ਸਭ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
One who does all the chanting and all the austerities, and shows every kind of cleverness,
wanders on the wrong road and does not take the right path.
ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ; ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Without understanding how to be God's servant, none of his efforts is accepted.
On the head of one empty of the Name, only ashes fall. ॥1॥
The Master is eternal, while the world is born and dies.
A being who turns to the Guru and becomes God's servant is saved. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The world is bound by attachment to Maya and by many hopes.
But some, following the Guru's teaching, stay detached.
The Name dwells within them, and the lotus of their heart stays in bloom.
ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ; ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
They have no dread of the round of birth and death. ॥2॥
The world is overcome by lust and caught in attachment to women;
attached to son and wife, it forgets the Name.
So it wastes its life in vain and loses the game of human birth.
But one who does the service the Guru teaches has excellent daily conduct. ॥3॥
Such a person is not swayed by Maya; outwardly, doing the world's work, he seems to assert himself,
ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ; ਲੇਪੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
but inwardly he stays free and is never stained by attachment;
he burns away attachment to Maya through the Guru's word,
and keeps the pure Name always in his heart. ॥4॥
He guards his wandering mind and holds it back from attachment to Maya:
that Sikh of the Guru whom God, by His grace, joins to the holy company.
Without the Guru a person strays from the right road and falls into the round of birth and death.
The one on whom God casts His glance of grace He joins to the company and unites with His feet. ॥5॥
You are beautiful, Lord, but if I try to tell how beautiful, it cannot be told.
Your virtues cannot be described; even if I try, their worth cannot be found.
Walking in Your will, all pains turn into comforts.
By praising the eternal Lord, all pains are erased. ॥6॥
ਕਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਵਾਜਾ; ਪਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਲਾ ॥
A state arises within where an instrument plays without hands and the beat is kept without dancing feet,
ਜੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝੈ; ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
when one understands the Guru's word and beholds the eternal Lord within.
Then the eternal Lord is manifest within him, and he feels nothing but comfort;
casting His glance of grace, the Protector keeps him safe. ॥7॥
One who sheds self-conceit sees God dwelling in all three worlds;
through the Guru's word he gains true understanding and stays merged in the eternal Lord.
He keeps the Guru's word in his thoughts and fixes his attention steadily on the one Lord.
O Nanak, blessed is his human life, and he makes others' lives beautiful too. ॥8॥2॥
Writing countless learned writings about God only breeds pride in the writer.
But if the mind is won over to God's virtues and the eternal Lord rests in one's attention, that alone is the true writing.
Speaking and talking of His virtues and reading again and again only add to the burden of pride.
Countless writings may be written, but God is beyond writing, and His virtues have no far shore. ॥1॥
Know only the one Lord to be such, beyond writing and eternal,
and understand that birth and death too are His command. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Through attachment to Maya the world lies bound in the dread of death,
and the bound one is freed only by cherishing the Name.
The Guru alone gives spiritual peace; no other can be found to give it.
This Name alone stands by you in this world and the next. ॥2॥
ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ; ਤਾਂ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Only when one dies to attachment through the Guru's word can he fix his attention on the one Lord.
Only when he ends the hold of the five that cannot be ended does he rid his mind of its wandering after Maya.
One who makes the Name dwell in his mind is freed in this very life,
and, facing the Guru, he merges in the eternal Lord. ॥3॥
The Lord who made the earth and the sky,
who made all creation and can destroy what He has made,
is Himself present within all, steadily;
He Himself grants grace, and asks no one's counsel. ॥4॥
O Lord, You Yourself are the brimming world-ocean, You Yourself the ruby and diamond in it;
You are pure, eternal, and the deep treasure of all virtues.
413: One who meets the Guru, the pir, enjoys the bliss of union with You.
You alone are the King, and You alone Your own minister. ॥5॥
The world is in pride's prison; only those who have killed pride are free.
Rare in the world is the wise one whose daily conduct matches his wisdom;
rare in the world is the pandit who also reflects;
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ; ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
without meeting the true Guru, all the world wanders in arrogance. ॥6॥
The world is in pain; rare is the person at peace.
The world is sick with vices, given to pleasures, and pines for spiritual virtues.
Forgetting God, the world loses its honour and is born and dies again and again.
One who turns to the Guru understands this secret. ॥7॥
If God were to be bought, His price would be far too high, and nothing weighs as much as He.
Through the Guru's teaching, keep that unshakeable Lord, whom none can deceive, in your heart.
He is met through love, and He is pleased when a being lives in awe of Him.
Nanak, the humble servant, tells this thought. ॥8॥3॥
One person dies, and his relatives gather and weep;
but those who wash the filth of attachment from their minds through the Guru's word lose their pride;
understanding that God's light is in all, they stay in stillness of mind.
Without this understanding, those who weep lose all their honour before God. ॥1॥
Who dies, and who weeps crying "he, he"?
ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ; ਸਭਸੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, Creator of all the world, You Yourself are over every being's head. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Whoever weeps for the dead is really pouring out his own troubles;
the one who weeps is the one on whom some hardship has fallen.
But the one to whom death comes recognises God's will,
that what happens is what the Creator Himself does. ॥2॥
Dying to the craving to live is, as it were, the boat to cross the ocean of attachment.
This high state is found in the refuge of the Lord of the world.
I am a sacrifice to the true Guru's feet.
The Guru is the ship; joined to his word, one crosses the dreadful ocean. ॥3॥
God is beyond all fear and Himself shines His light steadily within everyone,
yet, missing His Name, the world clings here to ritual impurity, there to untouchability.
Through evil thinking the world dies a spiritual death; what can one say in weeping over it?
Without devotion and without hearing His praises, beings fall into the round of birth and death. ॥4॥
For one who has died to self, his former friends truly weep,
and Maya's three qualities weep day after day,
for he has put away pain and pleasure and become alert in stillness of mind,
and has offered his body and mind to the love of God. ॥5॥
The one Lord dwells within all, seen in countless forms;
yet beings, forgetting Him, have made up endless other rites and religious works.
Without awe and devotion, human life goes to waste.
Those who meet and sing God's praises gain the aim of human life. ॥6॥
God, present within all, Himself as it were dies, and He Himself causes the death.
He Himself creates, and having created, Himself destroys.
O Lord of light, You Yourself made the creation, and You Yourself made its many kinds.
By reflecting on the word of His praise a being meets Him, and no wandering after ritual impurity remains. ॥7॥
The notion of ritual impurity torments those parted from the all-pervading Lord, and consumes the world.
ਸੂਤਕੁ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਥਾਇ ॥
Impurity is in fire, water and earth, in every place;
O Nanak, caught in the notion of impurity, the world falls into the round of birth and death.
Through the Guru's grace one should drink the nectar of God's Name. ॥8॥4॥
He reflects on his own life and values the precious Name,
whom the perfect Guru carries across with one glance of grace;
ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ; ਮਨ ਤੇ. ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੧॥
such a person trusts the Guru with a true heart, and his mind does not waver. ॥1॥
The Guru is such a banker and so deals as an assayer
ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ; ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that, by his unerring glance of grace, a being fixes his attention on the one Lord and crosses over. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who makes the excellent Name of the stainless Lord his capital,
who stays dyed in the eternal Lord, becomes pure and a true judge of worth, like an assayer;
through praise he enshrines the Guru, the Creator, in the still home of his heart. ॥2॥
Through the Guru's word he burns away his hopes and desires for Maya,
and he himself worships God and leads others to it;
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਵਾਟ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
from the Guru he finds the true road and the Lord's palace, his home. ॥3॥
414: The Lord whose being is pure like gold, who is light alone and beyond compare,
the Master of the three worlds, whose form is all this creation:
ਮੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ; ਸਾਚੁ ਅਖੂਟੁ ॥੪॥
that Lord's eternal, inexhaustible wealth of the Name has come into my hands. ॥4॥
The Lord who pervades the five elements, Maya's three qualities, the nine regions and the four directions,
who holds earth and sky in place by His power:
the Guru, the assayer, turns the mind running after the outward world back towards Him. ॥5॥
A fool is the one who does not see the Lord with his eyes,
whose tongue has not tasted the Name, who does not understand what the Guru teaches;
ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ; ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥੬॥
drunk on poisonous Maya, he quarrels with the world. ॥6॥
In the Guru's excellent company a person becomes excellent,
strives for spiritual virtues and washes away his faults.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ; ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥੭॥
Without the service the Guru teaches, stillness of mind does not come. ॥7॥
The Lord's Name is like precious diamonds, jewels and rubies,
ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
and it becomes the capital of one whose mind is pure as a pearl.
O Nanak, the one on whom the Guru, the assayer, casts his glance of grace is fulfilled. ॥8॥5॥
Turning to the Guru, find deep union with God within your mind and enjoy attention fixed on Him;
through the Guru, recognise within you the dwelling place of the Lord.
Facing the Guru, keep his word in your thoughts; it is the pass for your life's journey. ॥1॥
So, through love and devotion, one comes to high understanding.
The one who faces the Guru receives the eternal Name of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Day and night he keeps the Lord's pure, excellent dwelling within his heart,
and comes to deep union with the Lord who pervades the three worlds, free of craving.
You too, from the unerring Guru, come to understand His will. ॥2॥
Lasting joy stays within him, and no anxiety touches him;
the life-giving Name of supreme taste and deep union with God become his spiritual food.
If the world ended the five vices, all the world would be at peace. ॥3॥
O Lord, Your light shines in all creation, and every being is made by You.
He Himself unites beings and Himself parts them again.
Whatever the Creator Himself does is what happens. ॥4॥
He Himself pulls down creation and builds it again, and by His command it merges back in Him.
His command runs as it pleases Him.
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ; ਪੂਰਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
Without the Guru no one attains the perfect Lord. ॥5॥
One whose attention never turns to God, in childhood or old age,
but who in the fullness of youth stays drowned in pride:
missing the Name, what will he gain in the end? ॥6॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ; ਸਹਜਿ. ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
One who uses the food and wealth God gives yet never comes to know Him in stillness of mind,
and strays from life's road in wandering after Maya, regrets at last.
The noose of attachment stays round his neck, and he goes about forever crazed by it. ॥7॥
ਬੂਡਤ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਤਉ ਡਰਿ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
Those who see the world drowning in attachment and run from it in fear
are greatly fortunate, and the true Guru has saved them:
those who fall at the Guru's feet, O Nanak. ॥8॥6॥
Those who sing songs of devotion for others to hear, while evil thoughts sit in their minds,
who preach freedom from attachment and aversion and call themselves free of them,
without remembering the Name, have falsehood and wrongdoing in their minds. ॥1॥
O mind that gives others advice, why do you wander into wrongdoing? Stay within yourself.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ; ਖੋਜਤ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who turn to the Guru are sated by the Name and turn from vices; you too, searching through the Guru, will find the Lord in stillness of mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One in whose mind and body there are lust, anger and attachment,
within whom are craving, greed and pride, and their torment:
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
without remembering God's Name, how can his mind find courage to face them? ॥2॥
One who finds union with the eternal Lord within is bathing at a place of pilgrimage within his soul;
such a person, through the Guru, comes to know his own inner state.
ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ; ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
But without the Guru's true word no one can recognise the Lord's dwelling. ॥3॥
One who merges the visible world into the formless Lord, drawing his attention inward,
and enshrines in his heart, through remembrance, the eternal Lord whose power is beyond measure:
ਸੋ ਨਰੁ; ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥
that person does not come into the round of birth and death. ॥4॥
So I pray: wherever I may receive God's Name, there let me go,
415: By the Guru's grace, may I do only those deeds that bring the Name,
and, dyed in the Name, keep singing the Lord's praises. ॥5॥
One who, through the service the Guru teaches, has come to know his inner spiritual life,
has the life-giving Name, giver of bliss, dwelling in his mind.
Through the word of praise he stays dyed in the Name day after day. ॥6॥
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਏ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Only when my beloved Lord attaches someone to His Name does that one become attached,
and then, killing his pride through the Guru's word, he stays awake.
Here and hereafter, bliss is always there before him. ॥7॥
But the fickle mind does not know the way,
for one who follows his own mind stays filthy and finds no bond with the Guru's word.
One who walks the Guru's way repeats the Name and lives a pure life. ॥8॥
I make this prayer before the revered Lord:
may my dwelling be in the company of the holy,
ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੯॥
and may the Lord's Name shine within me and cut away my sins and sorrows. ॥9॥
One who reflects on the Guru's word and comes to understand good conduct,
and, walking by the true Guru's words, forms a bond with the one Lord,
O Nanak, has his mind dyed in the Lord's Name. ॥10॥7॥
Cut off from the Guru's word, the mind wrapped in Maya is like a mad elephant,
and roams the forest of the world, bewildered by attachment to Maya.
ਇਤ ਉਤ ਜਾਹਿ; ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਚਾਪੇ ॥
Those whom spiritual death presses down wander here and there.
One who faces the Guru searches and finds the Lord's dwelling within himself. ॥1॥
Without the Guru's word the mind cannot stay still in one place.
ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ. ਹਉਮੈ ਕਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Remember the Lord's Name, which is utterly pure, and give up other tastes, which are bitter and feed pride. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹਸੀ ॥
This mind loses its understanding; tell me, how can it stop wandering?
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝੇ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਸੀ ॥
Without understanding its own origin, it must bear the pain of spiritual death.
One on whom the Lord Himself bestows grace meets the Guru;
he overcomes painful spiritual death, and the eternal Lord urges him on towards spiritual life. ॥2॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
This mind, wrapped in Maya, goes about performing one religious rite after another,
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ; ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤੇ ਜਨਮਾ ॥
and this mind, born of the five elements, is kept in the round of birth and death.
Wrapped in Maya, this mind grows greedy and foolish.
One who repeats the Name facing the Guru has a mind of beautiful shape. ॥3॥
The mind of one facing the Guru gives the Lord a place within,
and he comes to understand the Lord who pervades the three worlds.
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ; ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ. ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
This mind is now a yogi, now an enjoyer of Maya, now torments the body with austerities, yet finds bliss nowhere.
One who faces the Guru searches out the Lord God within himself. ॥4॥
At times this mind gives up pride and turns renunciant;
at times, in every body, Maya's desires and a divided mind cling to it.
One who takes the Guru's refuge and tastes the Name, the home of all tastes,
ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ; ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥੫॥
sees within and without the Lord, master of the palace, who keeps his honour. ॥5॥
At times this mind plays king and warrior on the battlefield.
But when this mind takes the Guru's refuge and joins the Name, it becomes fearless,
kills the five enemies and brings them under its control,
and, ending pride, holds them all in one place. ॥6॥
Facing the Guru, this mind gives up attachment, aversion and other tastes;
in the Guru's refuge, joined to devotion, this mind stays awake.
One who holds the Guru's word in his thoughts hears the unbroken song of inner bloom and is absorbed in it,
and, searching his own self, becomes one with the Formless Lord. ॥7॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
When this mind faces the Guru it becomes pure and sees that Lord alone within and without.
Facing the Guru, a longing for devotion takes hold of it and love for the Lord awakens.
By the Guru's grace this mind praises the Lord day and night.
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ॥੮॥
The Lord who is the origin of all, there since the start of the ages, it sees dwelling in every body. ॥8॥
Facing the Guru, this mind is intoxicated with the Name, the home of all tastes,
and, facing the Guru, it recognises the Lord, the source of all tastes.
When it dwells at the Guru's feet, love for devotion awakens in it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ; ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੯॥੮॥
O Nanak, then this mind becomes the slave of the slaves of the Lord's people. ॥9॥8॥
416: ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਧਨੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
When the body perishes, the wealth one earned cannot be called one's own,
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਕਤ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
and the wealth of the Lord's Name cannot be had from anyone but the Guru.
The wealth of the Lord's Name alone is a person's true companion.
One who fixes his attention on the Lord day and night becomes pure. ॥1॥
Apart from the Lord's Name, who else is truly ours?
ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ, ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ; ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Taking pleasure and pain alike, I will never leave the Name; the Lord Himself, in His grace, unites us with Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Fools are those who grow attached to gold and woman,
and, forgetting the Name, are caught in wandering.
The one You bless by making him repeat Your Name sings Your praises,
ਦੂਤੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਸਕੈ; ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
and, as he sings them, no messenger of death can come near him. ॥2॥
O Lord, O God, O Sustainer of the world, You alone are the great giver.
As it pleases You, O merciful one, save me.
Through the Guru, the Lord has become dear to my mind;
my ailments are gone and I have held back the pain. ॥3॥
ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਅਉਖਧੁ; ਤੰਤ ਨ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
There is no other medicine, no charm and no spell.
Remembering the Lord alone destroys all sins.
O Lord, You Yourself make us forget the Name and lead us astray,
and You Yourself, in mercy, save us. ॥4॥
They suffer the disease of wandering, of distance from the Lord and of mine and yours,
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਭਰਮਿ; ਜਪਹਿ ਜਪੁ. ਦੂਜਾ ॥
who, without the Guru, go astray and chant another chant.
ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਗੁਰ; ਦਰਸ. ਨ ਦੇਖਹਿ ॥
Those who never see the Guru, the all-pervading Being who is the origin of all,
without the Guru's word, of what account is their birth? ॥5॥
Seeing You, O wondrous Lord, we are amazed.
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ; ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
You are in every body, in gods and in men, resting there unmoved of Your own accord.
You fill every mind and give each one support.
There is none equal to You. ॥6॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤੁ; ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Those who love His devotion and keep the Name in their mouths,
in the company of such saints and devotees the Lord is found.
Fixing their attention in stillness, they break their bonds.
One who faces the Guru, in whom the Guru's divine knowledge shines, is freed as well. ॥7॥
The pain of the messengers of death does not touch him,
ਜੋ ਜਨੁ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
the one whose attention stays awake in the Lord's Name.
The Lord, lover of devotion, stays with His devotees.
O Nanak, dyed in the Lord's love, they are set free. ॥8॥9॥
One who remembers the Lord as the Guru teaches comes to know Him everywhere;
he recognises the eternal Lord through the word, and his pain is erased. ॥1॥
O my friends and companions, repeat the Lord's Name;
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ; ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
serving the true Guru in this way, you will see God everywhere with your eyes. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Without remembrance, mother and father in the world become bonds,
and son, daughter and wife become bonds too. ॥2॥
Religious rites become bonds, as one boasts, "I did this, I did this."
If another love is in the mind, son and wife become bonds. ॥3॥
Farmers till the land, and without remembrance their farming becomes a bond.
ਹਉਮੈ ਡੰਨੁ ਸਹੈ; ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨ ॥੪॥
The king who demands revenue bears, without remembrance, the punishment of pride. ॥4॥
Without remembering the Name, the trader's trade is a root of bonds,
for, caught in the sprawl of attachment to Maya, he is never sated. ॥5॥
Merchants gather wealth, which leaves them in the end, and it becomes a bond.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ; ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥੬॥
Without devotion to the Lord, no effort is accepted. ॥6॥
Without remembrance, reading and composing the Vedas breed arrogance and become bonds.
Caught in the bonds of attachment and vice, a person dies a spiritual death. ॥7॥
O Nanak, those who take the support of the Lord's Name,
the true Guru has saved; no bond falls on them. ॥8॥10॥
417: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਿਨ ਸਿਰਿ. ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪਟੀਆ; ਮਾਂਗੀ ਪਾਇ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
Those whose heads were graced with braids, the parting filled with vermilion,
ਸੇ ਸਿਰ. ਕਾਤੀ ਮੁੰਨੀਅਨੑਿ; ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ. ਆਵੈ ਧੂੜਿ ॥
now have their heads shorn with scissors, and dust falls about their necks.
ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਦੀਆ; ਹੁਣਿ. ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲਨੑਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
They who lived in palaces are now not allowed even near them. ॥1॥
Salutation, O Lord, salutation to You.
ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ. ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਵੇਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Being there from the start, no one finds the secret of Your will; You enact it and watch it Yourself. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਦਹੁ. ਸੀਆ ਵੀਆਹੀਆ; ਲਾੜੇ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
When they came as brides, their bridegrooms looked handsome at their side;
ਹੀਡੋਲੀ ਚੜਿ ਆਈਆ; ਦੰਦ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
they came riding in palanquins, with ivory bangles adorning their arms.
ਉਪਰਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਾਰੀਐ; ਝਲੇ ਝਿਮਕਨਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Water was waved over them for good luck, and mirrored fans glittered in their hands. ॥2॥
ਇਕੁ ਲਖੁ ਲਹਨੑਿ ਬਹਿਠੀਆ; ਲਖੁ ਲਹਨੑਿ ਖੜੀਆ ॥
They received a hundred thousand when seated and a hundred thousand when standing;
they ate coconut and dates and enjoyed lovely beds.
ਤਿਨੑ ਗਲਿ. ਸਿਲਕਾ ਪਾਈਆ; ਤੁਟਨੑਿ, ਮੋਤਸਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
Now ropes are round their necks, and their strings of pearls are breaking. ॥3॥
ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਦੁਇ. ਵੈਰੀ ਹੋਏ; ਜਿਨੑੀ. ਰਖੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Wealth and youth, which kept them intoxicated, have both become their enemies.
ਦੂਤਾ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ; ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Babar has given orders to his cruel soldiers, who lead them away dishonoured.
ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ, ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ. ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
If it pleases Him He gives honour, and if He wills He gives punishment. ॥4॥
ਅਗੋ ਦੇ. ਜੇ ਚੇਤੀਐ; ਤਾਂ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
If one keeps one's duty in mind beforehand, why would such punishment come?
ਸਾਹਾਂ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ; ਰੰਗਿ ਤਮਾਸੈ ਚਾਇ ॥
The rulers had lost sight of their duty in pleasure and the thrill of shows.
ਬਾਬਰਵਾਣੀ. ਫਿਰਿ ਗਈ; ਕੁਇਰੁ. ਨ ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੫॥
Now that Babar's rule has been proclaimed, not even a Pathan prince can get bread to eat. ॥5॥
ਇਕਨਾ. ਵਖਤ ਖੁਆਈਅਹਿ; ਇਕਨੑਾ. ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Some, the Muslim women, miss their hours of prayer; others, the Hindu women, lose their time of worship.
ਚਉਕੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਹਿੰਦਵਾਣੀਆ; ਕਿਉ ਟਿਕੇ ਕਢਹਿ. ਨਾਇ ॥
Without their sacred cooking squares, how can the Hindu women bathe and put on their tilak marks?
ਰਾਮੁ. ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਚੇਤਿਓ; ਹੁਣਿ. ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ, ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੬॥
Those who never remembered Ram are now not allowed even to say Khuda. ॥6॥
ਇਕਿ. ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਪਣੈ; ਇਕਿ. ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਸੁਖ ॥
The few who escape come back to their homes, and, meeting, ask after one another's welfare;
ਇਕਨੑਾ. ਏਹੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
for some this was the lot written, and they sit together weeping over their sorrows.
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋ ਥੀਐ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨੁਖ ॥੭॥੧੧॥
Whatever pleases Him comes to pass; O Nanak, what can people do? ॥7॥11॥
ਕਹਾ. ਸੁ ਖੇਲ ਤਬੇਲਾ ਘੋੜੇ; ਕਹਾ. ਭੇਰੀ ਸਹਨਾਈ ॥
Where are those games, the stables and horses? Where are the drums and the pipes?
ਕਹਾ. ਸੁ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ ਗਾਡੇਰੜਿ; ਕਹਾ. ਸੁ ਲਾਲ ਕਵਾਈ ॥
Where are the sword belts of fine wool, and where the red uniforms?
ਕਹਾ. ਸੁ ਆਰਸੀਆ ਮੁਹ ਬੰਕੇ; ਐਥੈ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Where are the mirrors and the handsome faces? They are not seen here now. ॥1॥
O Lord, this world is Yours, and You are its master.
ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ; ਜਰੁ ਵੰਡਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਭਾਂਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In a moment He sets it up and pulls it down, and shares out wealth to others. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਹਾਂ. ਸੁ ਘਰ ਦਰ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਹਲਾ; ਕਹਾ. ਸੁ ਬੰਕ ਸਰਾਈ ॥
Where are those homes, gates, pavilions and palaces? Where are the fine inns?
ਕਹਾਂ. ਸੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਿ. ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Where is that comforting woman and her bed, the sight of whom drove away sleep?
ਕਹਾ. ਸੁ ਪਾਨ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਮਾ; ਹੋਈਆ ਛਾਈ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Where are the betel leaves and their sellers, and the veiled women? All have vanished. ॥2॥
ਇਸੁ ਜਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ, ਘਣੀ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ; ਇਨਿ ਜਰ. ਘਣੀ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
For this wealth many are ruined; this wealth has ruined many.
ਪਾਪਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ. ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਮੁਇਆ. ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
It cannot be gathered without sin and oppression, and it does not go with one at death.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਏ ਕਰਤਾ; ਖੁਸਿ ਲਏ ਚੰਗਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
Whom the Creator Himself leads astray, He first strips of his goodness. ॥3॥
ਕੋਟੀ ਹੂ ਪੀਰ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ; ਜਾ. ਮੀਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
When the rulers heard that Mir Babar was charging in, they held back countless pirs to work spells.
418: ਥਾਨ ਮੁਕਾਮ ਜਲੇ ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰ; ਮੁਛਿ ਮੁਛਿ ਕੁਇਰ ਰੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Strongholds and solid mansions burned, and the princes were cut to pieces and left rolling in the dust.
ਕੋਈ ਮੁਗਲੁ. ਨ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਧਾ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਰਚਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Not one Mughal was struck blind; no pir worked any miracle. ॥4॥
ਮੁਗਲ ਪਠਾਣਾ ਭਈ ਲੜਾਈ; ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਈ ॥
When the Mughals and Pathans fought, swords were wielded on the battlefield.
ਓਨੑੀ ਤੁਪਕ ਤਾਣਿ ਚਲਾਈ; ਓਨੑੀ ਹਸਤਿ ਚਿੜਾਈ ॥
The Mughals took aim and fired their guns, but in the Pathans' hands the guns only fizzled.
ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਚੀਰੀ. ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਟੀ; ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੫॥
But, O brother, those whose letter of life is torn by the Lord must die. ॥5॥
ਇਕ ਹਿੰਦਵਾਣੀ ਅਵਰ ਤੁਰਕਾਣੀ; ਭਟਿਆਣੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
Hindu women, Muslim women, and the women of the Bhatts and Thakurs:
ਇਕਨੑਾ ਪੇਰਣ, ਸਿਰ ਖੁਰ ਪਾਟੇ; ਇਕਨੑਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਸਾਣੀ ॥
some had their burqas torn from head to foot, and some found their dwelling in the cremation ground.
ਜਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਬੰਕੇ. ਘਰੀ ਨ ਆਇਆ; ਤਿਨੑ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
Those whose handsome husbands did not come home, how did they pass that night? ॥6॥
ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ; ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
To whom can this be told? The Creator Himself does all and makes others do it.
ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੋਵੈ; ਕਿਸ ਥੈ ਜਾਇ. ਰੂਆਈਐ ॥
O Creator, pain and pleasure come by Your will; to whom else can we go and weep?
ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਵਿਗਸੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੭॥੧੨॥
O Nanak, the Lord of the command runs the world by His command and is pleased; each receives what is written. ॥7॥12॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Asa Kafi · Ashtpadis · Guru Nanak · Ghar 8
As a herdsman takes his cattle to graze another's pasture, so is the world.
ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਆਦਮੀ; ਬਾਂਧਹਿ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Those people who build solid houses labour in vain. ॥1॥
ਜਾਗਹੁ ਜਾਗਹੁ ਸੂਤਿਹੋ; ਚਲਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Wake up, wake up, you who sleep: the trader is departing. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਘਰ ਬਾਂਧੀਅਹਿ; ਜੇ ਰਹਣਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Lasting houses would be built only if one were to stay here for ever,
ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਵੈ, ਜੀਉ ਚਲਸੀ; ਜੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
but, if anyone reflects, when the soul departs the body falls too. ॥2॥
ਓਹੀ ਓਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ; ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੋਈ ॥
Why cry "alas, alas"? The Lord, who is now, will always be.
ਤੁਮ ਰੋਵਹੁਗੇ ਓਸ ਨੋ; ਤੁਮੑ ਕਉ ਕਉਣੁ ਰੋਈ ॥੩॥
If you weep for the one who died, someone will weep for you too. ॥3॥
ਧੰਧਾ ਪਿਟਿਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ; ਤੁਮੑ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
Brothers, you beat your breasts in vain and do what is futile.
ਓਹੁ. ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਕਤ ਹੀ; ਤੁਮੑ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ॥੪॥
He does not hear it at all; you only make the people hear. ॥4॥
ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਤਾ. ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਜਾਗਾਏ ਸੋਈ ॥
O Nanak, the Lord by whose command a person sleeps is the one who wakes him.
ਜੇ ਘਰੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪਣਾ; ਤਾਂ ਨੀਦ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
If he understands which is his own true home, the sleep of attachment does not seize him. ॥5॥
ਜੇ ਚਲਦਾ ਲੈ ਚਲਿਆ; ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
If one who dies takes any wealth with him,
ਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ; ਬੂਝਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
then go on gathering wealth; look, reflect and understand. ॥6॥
ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ. ਮਖਸੂਦੁ ਲੈਹੁ; ਮਤ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
Do the trade by which you earn life's aim, or else you will regret it.
ਅਉਗਣ ਛੋਡਹੁ. ਗੁਣ ਕਰਹੁ; ਐਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਰਾਵਹੁ ॥੭॥
Leave bad deeds, take up virtues, and so earn the real profit. ॥7॥
ਧਰਮੁ ਭੂਮਿ. ਸਤੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਿ; ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਸ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
Make dharma the soil and pure conduct the seed, and farm in this way;
ਤਾਂ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਜਾਣੀਅਹੁ; ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥੮॥
then you will be known as wise traders, if you carry away the profit. ॥8॥
ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
One on whom grace falls meets the true Guru and understands this reflection.
ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ. ਸੁਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ; ਨਾਮੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥੯॥
He speaks the Name, hears the Name and deals in the Name alone. ॥9॥
ਜਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ. ਤੋਟਾ ਤਿਵੈ; ਵਾਟ ਚਲਦੀ ਆਈ ॥
As there is profit, so there is loss: this way has always gone on.
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਸਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੦॥੧੩॥
O Nanak, what pleases the Lord comes to pass, and that is His greatness. ॥10॥13॥
ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਢੂਢੀਆ; ਕੋ. ਨੀਮੑੀ ਮੈਡਾ ॥
I have searched the four corners, and no one is truly mine.
ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ; ਤੂ ਮੈ. ਹਉ ਤੈਡਾ ॥੧॥
O my Master, if it pleases You, be mine, and I will be Yours. ॥1॥
ਦਰੁ ਬੀਭਾ, ਮੈ ਨੀਮੑਿ ਕੋ; ਕੈ ਕਰੀ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
I find no other door; before whom should I bow?
ਹਿਕੋ ਮੈਡਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ; ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You alone are my Master; may Your eternal Name stay in my mouth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਿਧਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ. ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ; ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
To become siddhs and pirs, people serve the accomplished yogis and beg them for miraculous powers.
ਮੈ. ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੨॥
My prayer is that, by the wisdom of the unerring Guru, I never forget Your one Name. ॥2॥
419: ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਕਾਪੜੀ; ਕਿਆ ਭਵਹਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ॥
Yogis, enjoyers and patch-clad fakirs roam from land to land in vain.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਚੀਨੑਹੀ; ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰ ॥੩॥
They do not search out the Guru's word, the supreme reality that is ever the same. ॥3॥
ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾਧੇ ਜੋਇਸੀ; ਨਿਤ ਪੜ੍ਹਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
Pandits, teachers and astrologers keep reading the Puranas.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ; ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੁਕਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
They do not know the thing within; God lies hidden in the heart. ॥4॥
ਇਕਿ ਤਪਸੀ. ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਹਿ; ਨਿਤ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Some become ascetics, practising austerities in the forests and always living at places of pilgrimage.
ਆਪੁ. ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਤਾਮਸੀ; ਕਾਹੇ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
Full of anger, they do not search their own selves; what use is their renunciation? ॥5॥
ਇਕਿ. ਬਿੰਦੁ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਦੇ; ਸੇ ਜਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
Some hold back their seed by effort and call themselves celibates.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ. ਨ ਛੂਟਹੀ; ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੬॥
But without the Guru's word they are not freed, and, wandering, they keep coming and going. ॥6॥
ਇਕਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Some householders serve and strive at service, and follow the Guru's teaching.
ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੭॥
They repeat the Name, urge others to it and keep their conduct pure, and, firm in the Lord's devotion, they stay awake. ॥7॥
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥
Through the Guru the Lord's door and home are known; one who goes to the Guru recognises them.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
O Nanak, such a one does not forget the Name, and his mind is absorbed in the eternal Lord. ॥8॥14॥
ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੇ; ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸਚਿ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
Merge Maya's desire into the mind itself; joined to the eternal Lord one crosses the world-ocean.
ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤੂ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
O Master, You have been merciful since the start of creation and before the ages; I have come to Your refuge. ॥1॥
ਤੂ ਦਾਤੌ. ਹਮ ਜਾਚਿਕਾ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
O Lord, You are the giver and we are beggars at Your door; grant us Your vision.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru the Name is remembered, and the temple of the mind is drenched. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡੀਐ; ਤਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Only by leaving false greed does one form a bond with the eternal Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ; ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
Absorbed through the Guru's word, one understands life's highest aim. ॥2॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਲੋਭੀਆ; ਲੁਭਤਉ ਲੋਭਾਈ ॥
This greedy mind sets itself up as king and, caught in greed, keeps craving Maya.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਲੋਭੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
Facing the Guru, greed is removed, and love with the Lord is formed. ॥3॥
ਕਲਰਿ ਖੇਤੀ ਬੀਜੀਐ; ਕਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
If crops are sown in salty ground, how can there be any profit?
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ. ਸਚਿ ਨ ਭੀਜਈ; ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਗਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
One who follows his own mind is not drenched in the eternal Lord, and the false merges only into falsehood. ॥4॥
ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਅੰਧਿਹੋ; ਲਾਲਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Give up greed, you who are blind; greed brings heavy pain.
ਸਾਚੌ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
One in whose mind the eternal Master dwells kills the poison of pride. ॥5॥
Give up the divided mind, this wrong path, brothers, or you will be robbed.
In the true Guru's refuge, praise the Name day and night. ॥6॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਥਰੁ ਸੈਲੁ ਹੈ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਫੀਕਾ ॥
One who follows his own mind is a rock of stone; his life is tasteless and accursed.
ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕੇਤਾ ਰਾਖੀਐ; ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੂਕਾ ॥੭॥
However long it is kept in water, it stays dry inside. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ; ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
The Lord's Name is a treasure; the one to whom the perfect Guru gave it,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
O Nanak, never forgets the Name and, repeating it, drinks the life-giving nectar. ॥8॥15॥
The travelling souls are going on, having lost the true road of life;
ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ; ਸਚੁ. ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
the world toils, tangled in Maya, and the eternal Name is not dear to it. ॥1॥
ਕਿਆ ਭਵੀਐ. ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੀਐ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Why wander, why search, once the Guru's word has shown Him?
ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਸਰਜਿਆ; ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He casts out possessiveness and attachment and comes to dwell in his own true home. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ; ਕੂੜਿ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
The trader in truth meets the eternal Lord by joining Him; He is not found through falsehood.
ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
Fixing the mind on the eternal Lord, one does not come into birth again. ॥2॥
ਮੋਇਆ ਕਉ. ਕਿਆ ਰੋਵਹੁ; ਰੋਇ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹੂ ॥
Why weep for the dead? You do not know how to weep.
Weep in longing as you praise the eternal Lord, and recognise His command. ॥3॥
Know that each one comes into the world with his livelihood written by His command.
Recognise His command; this is how one gains the profit of life. ॥4॥
420: Within God's will a person leaves here having earned honour, and is respected in His court as well,
ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ; ਬੰਦਿ ਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥੫॥
and within His will, too, blows fall on people's heads and they are held in God's prison of birth and death. ॥5॥
If we settle in the mind that God's justice is at work everywhere, we earn the profit of the eternal Lord's Name.
Pride should be cast off: each being receives according to the imprint of its own deeds. ॥6॥
The soul-bride who follows her own mind is struck on the head, and is wasted away in the quarrel of attachment.
The dealer in falsehood is cheated and robbed, and is driven off from here bound in the noose of attachment. ॥7॥
Enshrine the Master in your heart, and you will not have to regret at the end.
Sing the praises of the Lord; He is the one who forgives all sins. ॥8॥
O Lord, Nanak asks for Your eternal Name; with Your grace, I would labour for it in the Guru's refuge.
ਮੈ. ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ; ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੯॥੧੬॥
I have no other support but You; look on me with Your gaze of grace. ॥9॥16॥
ਕਿਆ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਢੂਢੀ ਜਾਇ; ਮੈ. ਘਰਿ ਬਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ॥
What need is there to search the forest? For one who sees God everywhere, the green forest is in his own house.
ਸਚਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ; ਸਬਦਿ ਉਤਾਵਲਾ ॥੧॥
Whoever rests in the eternal Lord through the Guru's word, God comes at once to dwell in his heart. ॥1॥
ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Wherever I look, I see Him alone; there is no other but Him.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ; ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By doing the work the Guru teaches, one recognises God's dwelling everywhere. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ; ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
When the eternal Lord Himself joins a person to His feet, He becomes dear to that person's mind.
Such a one walks always in His will and is absorbed in His embrace. ॥2॥
ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
The one in whose mind the eternal Master comes to dwell sees that same Lord, dwelling in his mind, everywhere.
ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ; ਦੇ. ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
He is sure that God Himself gives honours, and that however much He gives, they never run short. ॥3॥
ਅਬੇ ਤਬੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ; ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
By flattering this side and that, how can one reach the Lord's presence?
ਪਥਰ ਕੀ ਬੇੜੀ. ਜੇ ਚੜੈ; ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਬੁਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
Such flattery is a boat of stone: whoever boards it sinks in the world-ocean. ॥4॥
ਆਪਨੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਚੀਐ; ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
If we sell our mind to the Guru and give our head along with it,
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ; ਅਪਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੫॥
then through the Guru we search our own heart and recognise the treasure of the Name within. ॥5॥
ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਖੀਐ; ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
Everyone speaks of the round of birth and death; the Creator Himself made it.
ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ. ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੬॥
Those who lose their selfhood and die to attachment are not gripped by birth and death again. ॥6॥
ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ; ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
A person does the very work that is ordered for him from the start,
ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਕਿਨਿ. ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
but if he hands his mind to the true Guru and rests at God's feet, no one can put a price on him. ॥7॥
ਰਤਨਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ; ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
The Master Himself assays these jewels He has made, and Himself sets their worth.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
O Nanak, the one in whose mind the Master comes to dwell receives honour that lasts for ever. ॥8॥17॥
ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
Those who, straying into other wandering, have forgotten the Name,
ਮੂਲੁ ਛੋਡਿ. ਡਾਲੀ ਲਗੇ; ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
leave the root and cling to the branches; they gain nothing for their spiritual life. ॥1॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਜੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
If someone comes to understand that without the Name there is no release from attachment,
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ. ਤ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
then by following the Guru's way he is set free, while one who follows his own mind loses his honour. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨੑੀ ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Those who have remembered the One Lord: their understanding does not fail.
ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ; ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
Such servants stay in the refuge of the Lord, the root of the world, from before the ages, untouched by Maya. ॥2॥
ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
My Master is beyond compare; there is no other like Him.
ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ, ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਾਚੇ ਪਰਥਾਈ ॥੩॥
If we rest in the support of the eternal Lord, by His grace we find spiritual bliss. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ, ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ; ਕੇਤੀ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
Many people point to other paths, but without the Guru's refuge no one finds God.
ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਵਾਟੜੀਂ; ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੪॥
Through the Guru, God Himself shows the path and makes eternal devotion firm in the heart. ॥4॥
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜੇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ; ਭੀ ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
But one who follows his own mind still goes astray, even when we try to explain the right way.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ. ਨ ਛੂਟਸੀ; ਮਰਿ ਨਰਕ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫॥
Without the Lord's Name he cannot escape; he brings spiritual death on himself and lives as if in hell. ॥5॥
ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
One who does not remember the Lord's Name is born and dies, and keeps wandering in that round.
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਨਾ ਪਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵੈ ॥੬॥
Without taking the Guru's refuge, the worth of the Name is not known. ॥6॥
